up: Retrieve chemical structures for all molecules that have at least one activity measurement tested against the human protein target Peptidyl-prolyl cis-trans isomerase NIMA-interacting 1 (CHEMBL2288). Include both the canonical SMILES representation of the chemical structure and a link to the molecular structure file (molfile) for each qualifying compound. No restrictions on assay types, activity types, units, or confidence scores should be applied. Provide a list of distinct compounds identified by their ChEMBL identifier (CHEMBL ID) and their corresponding canonical SMILES. Ensure that the target is identified using the target dictionary entry where target_type is 'SINGLE PROTEIN' and the pref_name matches the exact protein name 'Peptidyl-prolyl cis-trans isomerase NIMA-interacting 1' (CHEMBL2288). Return two columns: one for the ChEMBL ID of the molecule and one for the canonical SMILES. No ordering or ranking is required; return all matching rows.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molecule_chembl_id = md.molecule_chembl_id
JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molecule_chembl_id = cs.molecule_chembl_id
WHERE td.tid = 11004
AND td.pref_name = 'Peptidyl-prolyl cis-trans isomerase NIMA-interacting 1';

up: Retrieve all distinct compounds that have been tested against the human protein target Peptidyl-prolyl cis-trans isomerase NIMA-interacting 1 (CHEMBL2288) and return each compound's ChEMBL ID together with its canonical SMILES. The target must be identified from the target_dictionary table where the target_type is 'SINGLE PROTEIN' and the pref_name matches exactly 'Peptidyl-prolyl cis-trans isomerase NIMA-interacting 1' (CHEMBL2288). Include only molecules that have at least one activity measurement (any assay, any activity type, any units). Output two columns: the compound's ChEMBL ID and its canonical SMILES representation. No additional filtering, ordering, or ranking is required.
sql:
WITH target_compounds AS (
  SELECT a.molregno AS molregno,
         md.chembl_id AS chembl_id,
         cs.canonical_smiles AS canonical_smiles
  FROM activities a
  JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
  JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
  JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
  JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno
  WHERE td.pref_name = 'Peptidyl-prolyl cis-trans isomerase NIMA-interacting 1'
    AND td.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN'
)
SELECT DISTINCT chembl_id, canonical_smiles
FROM target_compounds
;
